title: Duplicate charge
text: I was charged twice for March. Please refund the duplicate payment today, or I will cancel my subscription.

title: Production outage
text: All users get an error when signing in. Our team cannot work and we need the service restored immediately.

title: A future purchase
text: Could you send me the pricing for a team of 20 and a comparison of your plans? We are evaluating options for next quarter; there is no rush.

title: The negation test
text: I do not want to cancel my subscription. I only need a copy of last month's invoice for our records. There is no rush.

title: A small suggestion
text: I love the product. Just a suggestion for the future: a darker theme would be nice. Nothing is broken and no action is needed now.

title: Leaving the service
text: Please cancel my subscription before it renews today. I have decided to leave and use another provider.

title: Cobrança duplicada
text: Fui cobrado duas vezes neste mês. Preciso do estorno hoje ou vou cancelar minha assinatura.

title: Uma nova equipe
text: Gostaria de conhecer os preços dos planos para uma equipe de vinte pessoas. Estamos planejando a compra para o próximo trimestre, sem urgência.
